owner: Dr. Rami and the DRHC team
summary: DRHC is led by a consultant spine surgeon, with phone and WhatsApp contact and several specialties. The booking path is unclear and a few visible details weaken the page.

findings.problem: The Make an appointment today section says Fill the form below, but no form fields appear. Booking otherwise depends on a button that redirects to an external link.
findings.cost: A patient who reaches the form and finds nothing, or is sent off the site, often gives up.
findings.fix: A working, short booking form on the page with a confirmation message.

findings.problem: The three hero banners (spine, gastroenterology, radiology) are image only links with no visible call to action.
findings.cost: The most prominent space on the page does not tell visitors what to do next.
findings.fix: Clear banners with a Book now button for each specialty.

findings.problem: Typos and inconsistency: customer representitve, Daycase Hospital and Day Case Hospital, Majan Clinic and Majan Wadi al safa, and page addresses with comprehencive and orhtopedic.
findings.cost: Typos on a medical site weaken trust, and inconsistent clinic names confuse patients about where to go.
findings.fix: A proofread build with consistent names and clean page addresses.

findings.problem: Only one testimonial is shown, with no rating, review count or before and after content. The WhatsApp icon appears to load from a staging domain.
findings.cost: Patients considering surgery want proof from patients like them, and a staging asset can break at any time.
findings.fix: A review wall pulled from your Google reviews and assets hosted on your own domain.

redesign: A booking first homepage with a short form, WhatsApp and a clear call to action on every specialty banner.
Proof beside every booking button: named consultants, real reviews and patient stories.
Specialty pages written to rank for searches like spine surgeon Dubai and orthopedic surgeon Dubai.
